# BAD-052 — Split admin/src/lib/accounts.ts (1706 lines) into lib/accounts/ behind a same-name barrel

## Brief
Plan: [[docs/spikes/bad-036/admin-accounts|admin-accounts spike]] (Charlotte, BADS-036).

Proposed: admin/src/lib/accounts.ts stays at its path as a barrel re-exporting the same 29 names over 13 files in admin/src/lib/accounts/; all 58 declarations are placed once. Two files over 250 are argued: detail.ts about 295 and detail-types.ts about 255.

Phase 2 touch points: test/server/admin-accounts-list.test.mjs and test/server/admin-version-key.test.mjs read this file by path and are re-pointed in the same PR (VERSION_MATCH stays pinned against _shared/clientversion.mjs).

Verification: the admin's lint, typecheck and build, the export-diff script and the moved-exactly-once script in the spike's section 8, and npm test for the re-pointed server tests.

**Gate.** Queued until Eric approves the proposed file layout in the spike. Phase 2 does not start before that approval, and an approval that changes the layout is written into the spike's section 4 first.

**Rules for Phase 2, from BAD-036.** Split by responsibility; 250 lines is where a file gets a second look, not a cap, and every file left over 250 is argued in the spike's section 6. Every PR is a pure move: no statement is edited, a bug found on the way is its own ticket, and the spike's behaviour-preservation check (section 8) runs on every PR. The public surface in section 2 is the compatibility contract and does not change. Extraction order follows section 9: shared constants, types and pure utilities first, then state and services, then sub-components or handlers, then the entry file reduced to an orchestrator. Verification is the implementing-changes skill's tier for the files touched, quoted in each PR.

## Size, persona and model decision
Phase 2, one PR (Eric, 2026-09-15): one engineer on opus builds the whole split in a worktree on feat/bad-052-split-admin-accounts after bash scripts/worktree-init.sh; one reviewer on opus re-proves the pure move (spike section 8, steps 0-5) before the PR opens. Layout approved as proposed: accounts.ts stays the file barrel beside admin/src/lib/accounts/, not an index.ts.
